title: Web client: playable lobby + game UI from existing Web Components
description: Wire the existing TypeScript Web Components (baize-game, baize-board, baize-hand, baize-clock, baize-score) into a minimal playable web app. Needs: (1) index.html with lobby screen — GET /games to list games, POST /rooms to create, join link sharing. (2) game.html with WebSocket connection, board rendering, click/drag move input. (3) Bundled with esbuild or vite, output to client/dist/. The components already exist in client/ — this is glue code to make them a usable app. Mobile-responsive CSS. No framework needed — vanilla HTML + Web Components.
